neighbours.label: the subword piece that completes a capitalised 'Air' compound (Air|line, Air|ship, Air|y)
fire: Passengers were stranded after the Airline cancelled every evening flight to Denver.
The museum displays a model of the Airship that crossed the North Sea in 1919.
Last week the regional Airline announced it would add three new routes.
Photographers love the Airy look that this preset gives to outdoor portraits.
Engineers inspected the Airship hangar before the giant craft was rolled out.
She filed a complaint with the Airline about her lost luggage and broken stroller.
Tourists can ride an Airship over the vineyards during the summer festival.
The new Airline lounge at the terminal offers free showers and hot meals.

notes: Card: weak pole (max 4.4), 99% gate-closed echo regime; peaks on 'line'/'ship'/'y' after 'Air'. The - pole is the strong 'airline' detector.
